about: Curated typefaces the brand generator may use. Every family is OFL or Apache, fetched from its source with its license file, so it can ship in client downloads. `character`, `why` and `caution` are editorial judgments, not facts. Run `pnpm fonts fetch` to download and verify, `pnpm fonts specimen` to review.

rules.status: candidate = awaiting review; approved = generator may use; rejected = kept here so it isn't re-proposed
rules.override: An excluded or rejected family needs an explicit, written override from the user in the brand's strategy.md

excluded.reason: The default UI face of the decade; reads as no decision
Android system face; reads as default

excluded.family: DM Sans / DM Serif / DM Mono

excluded.reason: AI and crypto landing page default
The 2024-25 'tasteful AI startup' serif; now a cliche

families.character: Newspaper grotesk with a slightly squarish, editorial voice
families.why: Made for a media group, so it carries authority without looking corporate

families.character: Quiet, open grotesk; a workhorse with a little warmth
families.why: A credible text face to sit under an expressive display face, without being Inter

families.character: Agency grotesk with idiosyncratic details at large sizes
families.why: Personality shows in headlines and disappears in text

families.character: Neo-grotesk with a width axis, precise and slightly condensed
families.why: The width axis gives a brand a compressed display voice and a normal text voice from one family
families.caution: Its sibling Instrument Serif is excluded as a cliche; don't pair them

families.character: Quirky, ink-trapped grotesk with French-grotesque roots; loud at display sizes
families.why: Optical size axis means it can be wild at 120px and sensible at 14px
families.caution: Getting popular; already used in the Okonkwo fixture

families.character: Contemporary grotesk with a touch of geometric softness
families.why: Recent and not yet over-seen; good for clean software brands that need one family

families.character: Display grotesk with tapered joins that pinch where strokes meet
families.why: A built-in signature detail, useful as the starting point for a modified wordmark

families.character: American-gothic grotesk with a wide width range, from condensed to expanded
families.why: Very wide range in one family; the expanded widths have real presence

families.character: Neutral, strong grotesk made for the US Web Design System
families.why: Civic and trustworthy; suits fintech, govtech and compliance clients

families.character: Grotesk built for low-vision legibility; distinct letter shapes with a slightly odd charm

families.character: Friendly, slightly rounded humanist sans from an insurance brand

families.character: Sturdy grotesk whose heavy weights look like posters

families.character: Low-contrast sans with flare and volume axes that morph it toward flared serif

families.character: Engineered grotesk with squared curves; corporate-technical

families.character: Grotesk with sharp, slightly flared details and strong heavy weights

families.character: Grotesk with gently squarish curves; technical but soft

families.character: Condensed industrial gothic inspired by Chicago

families.character: Heavy old-style serif with soft, chunky shapes
